example_sentences_in_bangla: বাজারে হঠাৎ একটা জিকির শুনে সবাই চমকে উঠল।
সে রাগে জিকির করে চিৎকার করল।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone was startled by a sudden loud zikir in the market.
He shouted with a shrill zikir in anger.
history: Refers to the Islamic practice of zikr (remembrance of God through repetitive chanting), common in Bengali Muslim communities, often performed loudly in devotional gatherings.
note: Variations in spelling (জিকির/জিকীর/জিগির/জিগীর) reflect dialectical pronunciations in Bengali.
